# Talata Basketball

> Copenhagen's Constraints-Led Approach (CLA) basketball club. Serving ages 5 to adult since 2021. Built on three values: Joy, Excellence, Respect.

Talata Basketball is a registered Danish forening (CVR 43599453) based in Copenhagen. We run year-round programs for kids and adults, plus international camps to Canada and Lithuania. We're a member of Danmarks Basketball Forbund (DBBF) and DGI.

## Programs (from August 1, 2026 for the 26/27 season)

- [Mini (ages 5-7)](https://talatabasketball.dk/mini): Mon + Wed 15:00-16:00, Strandvejsskolen
- [Junior (ages 8-11)](https://talatabasketball.dk/mini): Tue + Thu 15:00-16:00, Strandvejsskolen
- [Academy (ages 12-19)](https://talatabasketball.dk/academy): Tue evenings @ Nørrebrohallen, Thu evenings @ Svanemøllehallen
- [Talata Men (competitive senior)](https://talatabasketball.dk): Thu + Fri evenings, Svanemøllehallen + Nørrebrohallen
- [Talata Fitness (adult rec)](https://talatabasketball.dk): Thu evenings @ Svanemøllehallen
- U17/U19 Girls: Coached by Talata in partnership with Stevnsgade, Tue @ Kulturhuset Indre By

Note: the 2026/27 season starts Monday August 10, 2026. Mini runs Tue + Thu, Junior runs Wed + Fri, Academy and Men train evenings Mon-Fri, Saturday open gym 10:00-15:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By.

## Coaching philosophy

Talata runs a fully Constraints-Led Approach (CLA) — ecological dynamics applied to basketball. Skill emerges from the interaction of Task + Environment + Individual. Every session uses small-sided games and game-like problems. No block practice. No form cues. No lines. No over-coaching.

Five Pillars: Bamboo Mindset · Repetition Without Repetition · Lag-Free Excellence · Autonomy & Discovery · Representative Integrity.

Full philosophy: https://talatabasketball.dk/philosophy
